subject: CloudRelay CPPO setup — pricing matrix & entitlement mapping
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Porter <alex@cloudrelay.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-16T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: CloudRelay CPPO setup — pricing matrix & entitlement mapping

Hi Alex,

Great catching up this morning — excited to get the Channel Partner Private Offer (CPPO) kicked off for CloudRelay. To keep the handoff tight with AWS and our finance/legal teams, can you confirm the items below so we can prepare the private-offer payload?

Ask list (quick):
- AWS Seller ID (12-digit) you want associated with the private offer
- Legal billing entity name and country (for invoicing / tax)
- PO contact name/email and preferred purchase order flow
- Primary SKU(s) you want mapped (list of internal SKU IDs and friendly names)
- Target pricing tiers (list as per attached pricing template)
- Any reseller-specific entitlements (seat caps, support tiers)

I've attached a CPPO_pricing_template.xlsx and a draft MSA (MSA_for_resellers.pdf) for your review — please treat the MSA as an initial draft; Irene will follow up on legal redlines.

Proposed timeline: if we get the info by EOD Friday (11/18), we can assemble the private-offer, run it past AWS seller support next week, and aim for a 11/28 go-live. Is that timeline realistic for you?

Thanks — I can host a 30-min hang to walk through mapping if helpful.

Cheers,
Soojin
Partner Lead | Redwood Inference
attachments: [CPPO_pricing_template.xlsx (spreadsheet), MSA_for_resellers.pdf (PDF)]

From: Alex Porter <alex@cloudrelay.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudRelay Legal <legal@cloudrelay.io>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-16T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CloudRelay CPPO setup — pricing matrix & entitlement mapping

Hi Soojin — thanks, and yes we want to move fast. Answers below inline.

- AWS Seller ID: 987654321012
- Legal billing entity: CloudRelay, Inc. ( Delaware, USA )
- PO contact: Maria Gonzales <purchasing@cloudrelay.io> — we typically send a PO PDF to accounting@redwood.com
- SKUs: we will map three SKUs — CR-CORE, CR-EDGE, CR-ENTERPRISE. I attached a simple CSV in the zip that contains the internal SKU ids to match your pricing template.
- Pricing tiers: see attached CPPO_pricing_inputs.csv inside CloudRelay_Entity_Docs.zip — first-pass prices are included; we're open to a quick negotiation on enterprise tier.
- Entitlements: CR-ENTERPRISE includes 24/7 support and a 99.9% uptime SLA; CR-EDGE is restricted to region-specific nodes (us-east/us-west).

Timeline: 11/28 go-live is fine assuming the MSA routing finishes by 11/22. I'll get the legal team to review and sign — they prefer DocuSign.

Attachments (stubs): CloudRelay_Entity_Docs.zip (contains CPPO CSV, entity docs, W9).

Best,
Alex Porter
Head of Channel Partnerships | CloudRelay
On Thu, Nov 16, 2028 at 9:12 AM Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Alex,
> 
> Great catching up this morning — excited to get the Channel Partner Private Offer (CPPO) kicked off for CloudRelay....

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Porter <alex@cloudrelay.io>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-16T12:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CloudRelay CPPO setup — pricing matrix & entitlement mapping

Alex — copying legal/ops notes so we get required artifacts. Two quick asks before we submit to AWS:

1) Can you send a signed W-9 (or equivalent tax form) for CloudRelay, Inc. — we need it for our finance team. You mentioned it's in the zip, but we need a signed PDF.
2) SOC 2 evidence: if CloudRelay already has a SOC 2 report, please point to the evidence share or attach the summary. Our compliance team will request access to the auditor letter if needed.

I also attached a short CPPO_instructions.pdf (internal) that outlines the fields AWS requires for the private offer payload. It includes the mapping template that Vanessa will use to create entitlement rules.

If you need redline turnaround on the MSA, please flag which section (payment terms, indemnity, data handling) you expect to change.

Thanks — Irene
Sr. Partner Operations | Redwood Inference
attachments: [redwood_cppo_instructions.pdf (PDF)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alex Porter <alex@cloudrelay.io>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-16T14:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CloudRelay CPPO setup — pricing matrix & entitlement mapping

Alex — thanks for the quick responses. I built a short go/no-go checklist and the DocuSign envelope to accelerate routing. Please review and sign the MSA via the link below; once signed we'll:

- Finalize the pricing lines into the AWS private-offer payload
- Provision entitlement mapping in our entitlement service
- Trigger AWS Marketplace private-offer submission and seller-support verification

DocuSign (MSA): https://docusign.com/embedded-sign/abc123
AWS private-offer draft (internal link): https://console.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/management/private-offers/12345

A couple of notes internally for Redwood: Ben — I need the billing entity mapping to our invoice system once we receive the signed W9; Irene — please prep the compliance intake for SOC2 access.

Target go-live: per Soojin/Alex, aiming 2028-11-28. If anything slips, please call out the blocker ASAP.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Channel Sales Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Alex Porter <alex@cloudrelay.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-16T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CloudRelay CPPO setup — pricing matrix & entitlement mapping

Vanessa / team — thanks. I confirmed the signed W-9 is attached to the CloudRelay_Entity_Docs.zip and I'll upload the signed MSA to the DocuSign link by Monday morning (11/20).

We are comfortable with the 11/28 target — we'll prioritize any changes flagged by Irene. One clarification: for CR-EDGE region restriction, can we add a note in the private-offer that product is limited to us-east-1 and us-west-2? If that requires an additional entitlement rule on your side, let us know and we can flag it explicitly in the SKU csv.

I'll follow-up with Maria (purchasing) and get the PO workflow started.

Best,
Alex
Head of Channel Partnerships | CloudRelay
